sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Falcons final injury report: Emeka Egbuka ruled out for Sunday’s game
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers released their final injury report Friday ahead of Sunday’s NFC South matchup against the Atlanta Falcons, with wide receiver Emeka Egbuka officially ruled out and two other players listed as questionable. Egbuka (foot) did not participate in Friday’s practice after being limited Wednesday and Thursday. The rookie receiver has cleared concussion […]
